added.description:
DLA Piper is, at its core, bold, exceptional, collaborative and supportive. Our people are the backbone, heart and soul of our firm. Wherever you are in your professional journey, DLA Piper is a place you can engage in meaningful work and grow your career. Let’s see what we can achieve. Together.

Summary

The Director, Engineering is responsible for leading the design, development, delivery, modernization, and ongoing support of enterprise technology solutions that enable the firm’s legal and business operations.

This role provides strategic and operational leadership for software engineering, application development, and systems integration, and engineering delivery functions, ensuring solutions are secure, scalable, maintainable and aligned with enterprise and value stream priorities.

The Director, Engineering partners closely with value stream leadership, IT services leaders, and business stakeholders to deliver high-quality technology capabilities that improve attorney and business professional productivity, enhance client experience, and support revenue growth and operational efficiency.

This role is accountable for engineering execution discipline, technical quality, delivery reliability, and the evolution of reusable engineering and platform capabilities that accelerate the firm's transition to a build-capable technology organization.

Location

This position can sit in any of our U.S. offices and offers a hybrid work schedule.

Responsibilities

Provide strategic leadership for engineering and application development teams supporting firmwide legal and business capabilities across value streams.
Set technical direction, architectural standards, and engineering practices to ensure solutions are secure, scalable, maintainable, and operationally sustainable.
Partner closely with IT, legal operations, and business stakeholders to translate business outcomes and value stream priorities into executable technology roadmaps and engineering delivery strategy, keeping a user experience and product value mindset at the forefront.
Lead engineering execution and continuous delivery of technology capabilities, balancing innovation, platform stability, technical debt reduction, risk management, and operational excellence.
Collaborate across IT functions to improve delivery flow, reduce bottlenecks, and increase engineering throughput and reliability.
Oversee engineering efforts across multiple product and platform workstreams, balancing innovation, operational stability, quality, risk, and delivery commitments.
Establish and promote engineering best practices including automation, CI/CD, observability, resiliency, testing, reusable engineering capabilities, and operational readiness.
Manage engineering budgets, vendor relationships, consultant resources, and third-party development partners as applicable to the success of the service portfolio and deliverables.
Lead, develop, and retain engineering management and senior technical talent, including performance management and succession planning.
Establish governance, metrics, and reporting for engineering performance, platform health, technical debt, operational sustainability, and delivery outcomes.
Ensure compliance with firm security, risk, governance, privacy, and data protection standards across all engineering activities.
Partner with infrastructure, operations, SRE, and end-user support teams to ensure stable production operations and smooth lifecycle support for delivered capabilities.
Provides leadership to and manages a team of business professionals to include coaching, mentoring and professional development. Responsible for providing performance feedback on a regular basis.

Desired Skills

Enterprise application architecture and modern development practices. Strategic planning and execution in complex environments. People leadership and organizational development. Financial and vendor management. Stakeholder partnership and executive communication. Risk management, security awareness, and operational excellence.

Minimum Education

Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field.

Preferred Education

Master's Degree in Technology, business, or management‑related discipline.

Certifications

Relevant certifications in cloud platforms, architecture, or technology leadership are preferred.

Minimum Years Of Experience

10+ years of progressive experience in software engineering or application development, including at least five years in a senior leadership or management role overseeing multiple teams or portfolios.

Essential Job Expectations

While the specific job requirements of a DLA Piper position may vary depending upon scope of the job and area of specialty, there are certain universal requirements that are expected of all DLA Piper employees, which include but are not limited to:

Effectively communicate, verbally and in writing, with clients, lawyers, business professionals, and third parties;
Produce deliverables, answer phone calls, and reply to correspondence in an efficient and responsive manner;
Provide timely, accurate, and quality work product;
Successfully meet deadlines, expectations, and perform work duties as required;
Foster positive work relationships;
Comply with all firm policies and practices;
Engage in both physical and sedentary activity, such as (a) working at a computer for extended periods of time, including on-screen reading and typing; (b) participating in digital/virtual conference calls; (c) participating in meetings as needed;
Ability to work under pressure and manage competing demands in a fast-paced environment;
Perform all other duties, tasks or projects as assigned.

Our employees are expected to embrace and uphold our firm values as a part of our DLA Piper culture. We are committed to excellence in how we represent our clients and develop our people.

Physical Demands

Sedentary work: Exerting up to 10 pounds of force occasionally and/or a negligible amount of force frequently or constantly to lift, carry, push, pull or otherwise move objects, including the human body. Sedentary work involves sitting most of the time. Jobs are sedentary if walking and standing are required only occasionally and all other sedentary criteria are met.   

Work Environment   

The individual selected for this position may have the opportunity for a hybrid work arrangement comprised of remote and in-office work, the requirement for which will be determined in coordination with the hiring manager or supervisor and may be modified in the firm’s discretion in the future.

Who We Are

Samsung HME America (Healthcare and Medical Equipment) is Samsung’s U.S. medical imaging organization, delivering advanced diagnostic solutions across Ultrasound, Digital Radiography, and Computed Tomography. We lead nationwide sales, marketing, service, and distribution of Samsung’s imaging technologies, partnering with healthcare providers to strengthen diagnostic capabilities, streamline clinical workflows, and support better patient care. Samsung HME America also serves as the global manufacturing center for Samsung’s mobile Computed Tomography (mCT) business, leading the development of advanced CT systems used by healthcare providers worldwide.

Backed by Samsung Electronics’ global technology leadership, our teams work closely with clinicians to translate real-world challenges into innovative imaging solutions. Our culture combines a sense of urgency, customer focus, and clinical collaboration to advance the future of medical imaging.

Role Description

The Director of Engineering is responsible for leading a cross-functional team in the development of new products and the continuous improvement of existing products for the Mobile Computed Tomography business. The Director of Engineering works closely with cross-functional teams, including Service, Manufacturing, Quality, Regulatory Affairs, Clinical Applications and Product Management, to deliver innovative, reliable, and cost-effective solutions to fulfill the company’s Market, Product & Technology strategy.

This is a great opportunity to be part of a growing business that makes a difference in the quality of people’s lives. Mobile CT is a transformation of fixed imaging technologies into point-of-care platforms, bringing the power of innovative imaging to patients.

Key Duties And Responsibilities, Other Duties May Be Assigned

Technical Leadership & Engineering Excellence

Drive technology collaboration across business units to accelerate innovation and leverage enterprise capabilities.
Collaborate with researchers, customers and product management to drive continuous improvement of our products and generate generational product plans to address unmet customer needs.
Facilitate the technology and product roadmap necessary to achieve medium-to-long-term market strategy.
Serve as process owner for New Product Introduction (NPI) and product improvement process.
Establish, monitor and continuously improve Engineering metrics and operational performance to drive efficiency, scalability, and productivity.
Own and advocate for the division’s intellectual property strategy; actively support invention disclosure, patent development, and IP portfolio growth.
Promote agile methodologies, engineering best practices, and operational excellence.
Enable technical leaders to make sound architectural and technical decisions.
Monitor organizational health metrics such as retention, engagement, delivery, and quality.
Remove organizational obstacles that impact engineering effectiveness.

Planning & Resource Utilization

Partner with engineering and product leaders to prioritize initiatives and allocate resources effectively across teams.
Optimize team capacity, workload balancing, and staffing to maximize productivity and delivery outcomes.
Evaluate current and future resource needs, including hiring, contractor utilization, and budget planning.
Monitor resource utilization, team velocity, and organizational capacity to identify risks and opportunities for improvement.
Drive quarterly and annual planning processes, ensuring alignment between strategic objectives and engineering execution.
Collaborate with Finance, HR, and executive leadership on headcount planning, forecasting, and budget management.

Financial Leadership

Develop and manage the engineering organization's annual operating and capital budgets.

Monitor budget performance, analyze variances, and implement corrective actions to ensure fiscal responsibility.

Identify opportunities for cost optimization while maintaining product quality, reliability, and employee experience.

10+ years of experience in design, manufacturing and service of Computed Tomography or analogous experience in another medical imaging modality required.

The Director of Engineering for Substation is a senior leadership role responsible for overseeing the planning, design, and implementation of Substation projects. Contribute to the development of the company's strategic plans and objectives, particularly in the areas of transmission and substation infrastructure.

Collaborate with other departments, such as Operations, Finance, and Regulatory Affairs, to align engineering initiatives with broader business goals.

Minimum of 15 years’ experience in the electric utility industry performing engineering related duties and/or management for high voltage electrical projects.
Bachelor of Science degree (B.S.) or Graduate degree in Electrical Engineering from an ABET accredited university.

Excellent business acumen and experience managing departmental budgets.

Experience interpreting internal and external business issues, recommending best practices, mitigating risk and solving complex problems.

Excellent communication, interpersonal, and leadership skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with internal teams, clients, and external partners.
Demonstrated ability to develop and execute strategic plans, drive innovation, and achieve business objectives.

Organizational Context

The APS is one of the world’s most productive hard X-ray light sources and a national scientific resource operated by Argonne National Laboratory for the U.S. Department of Energy. The APS Engineering Support Division delivers the mechanical, electrical, controls, safety, information technology, and information solutions capabilities required to operate the accelerator complex and the associated beamlines and provides engineering services to the broader APS scientific enterprise. Own engineering outcomes across PatientPoint’s device product areas — field operations tooling, exam-room technology, waiting-room displays, and back-office systems.
Serve as the Engineering Manager for a mix of senior Engineering Leads and individual-contributor engineers — owning hiring, performance, and career growth directly — and step into the Engineering Lead’s technical-direction role yourself where a team needs it.
Stay close to the code: lead code reviews, contribute directly where needed, and guide teams on technical best practices.
Champion AI-assisted and agentic engineering practices — in your own work, across your teams’ day-to-day development, and in the AI-powered capabilities we build into our products (e.g., automated device diagnostics).
Coordinate priorities and dependencies across three or more concurrently active product areas with different tech stacks and team maturity.
Contribute to cross-org architecture discussions (ARB/RFCs), bringing a device-fleet perspective to architecture trade-off conversations.
Help engineers and Engineering Leads grow in their roles and career paths at PatientPoint.
Partner closely with Product and Design leads on execution across the device product areas.
Manage a blended team of full-time and contract engineers, onshore and offshore.
Escalate organizational, staffing, and resourcing needs for the device product areas to engineering leadership.

What We Need

10+ years of software engineering experience, including 2+ years leading engineers or engineering teams.
Recent hands-on technical involvement within the last 1–2 years, such as contributing to production code, reviewing pull requests, designing implementations, creating architecture plans, or directly troubleshooting and fixing software defects.
Given the hands-on nature of this role, candidates will complete a coding assessment as part of the interview process to evaluate their current technical proficiency.
Current hands-on experience with native Android development using Kotlin and modern Android development practices.
Experience with AOSP, customized Android ROMs, rooted or kiosk-mode Android devices, APK distribution, or Android OS upgrade programs.
Experience with Android device-platform development beyond traditional consumer mobile applications.
Experience with Java in addition to Kotlin.
Experience with JavaScript or TypeScript and React-based front-end development.
Experience building software for connected, managed, or remotely deployed devices, with an understanding of the operational challenges associated with physical device fleets.
Experience leading engineers across multiple concurrent products, workstreams, or technical domains.
Experience managing and developing engineers, including hiring, performance management, coaching, and career development.
Strong understanding of the constraints associated with deployed devices, including limited memory, storage, or processing power; intermittent connectivity; remote software updates; and supporting multiple hardware or OS generations.
Experience supporting remotely deployed device fleets, including considerations such as staged releases, monitoring fleet health, remote troubleshooting, and software update or rollback strategies.
Experience with backend technologies supporting device fleets, such as Kotlin/JVM services, Node.js, serverless architectures, or similar microservice environments.
Hands-on use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Cursor, Claude, or similar tools, along with experience encouraging or driving their adoption within an engineering team.
Working knowledge of cloud-based services and APIs that support connected-device applications.
Experience managing blended teams of full-time employees and contractors.

Desired Qualifications

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, engineering, information systems, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.
Experience with BrightSign or other digital signage/device-management platforms such as SignageOS or Broadsign.
Experience with IoT technologies and protocols such as AWS IoT Core, MQTT, Device Shadow, BLE, or GATT.
Experience with Jetpack Compose.
Experience contributing to an architecture review process such as ARB, RFCs, or an equivalent technical-governance model.
Experience operating in a product-operating-model or product-trio structure.
Experience guiding or contributing to AI-powered product capabilities such as automated diagnostics, self-healing device operations, or similar AI-driven features.
Experience with agent-orchestration frameworks or patterns such as MCP-based tool access, AWS Bedrock AgentCore, Strands Agents, or similar approaches.
Experience with Kotlin Multiplatform or similar cross-platform native architectures.
Experience developing, tracking, or improving engineering delivery metrics such as DORA.
Experience with vulnerability management, application security, or security reviews for distributed or device-based systems.
Experience in healthcare or another regulated industry.
Experience leading through organizational change or team transitions.

What You'll Need to Succeed

Ability to lead teams in delivering product features while continuously improving software quality and development practices.
Comfort remaining technically hands-on and working alongside engineers on code, architecture, implementation, and device-level issues.
Strong ability to develop talent and help engineers grow into larger technical and leadership roles.
Strong judgment around when to provide technical direction versus empowering senior engineers and Engineering Leads to own decisions.
Excellent collaboration and communication skills across Product, Design, Architecture, and other engineering teams.
Ability to balance near-term delivery with long-term maintainability, reliability, and operational excellence

Mentor and develop your team

Hands-On Technical Leadership

Hands-on experience with retrieval augmented generation, agent frameworks, tool use, and orchestration patterns.
Experience with foundation model platforms such as AWS Bedrock, Azure OpenAI, or equivalent.
Deep understanding of large language model application architecture, including retrieval, context management, tool use, agent design, and orchestration.
Strong grasp of AI evaluation methods, safety and security concerns, and cost awareness for AI systems.

added.description:
Job Description

This leader owns the technical execution of a portfolio of marketing applications, shared services, integrations, automation, and data-enabled capabilities. The role sits at the intersection of marketing, product, data, and engineering and is responsible for translating business problems into scalable technical solutions rather than simply administering individual marketing platforms.

The Senior Manager leads both people and technology: establishing engineering practices, guiding solution architecture, developing technical talent, managing the application roadmap, and ensuring the team's products are secure, reliable, interoperable, measurable, and maintainable.

Responsibilities

Technology Leadership & Strategy

Lead the MarTech engineering function and establish the technical strategy for internally developed marketing applications, integrations, automation, and shared services.
Translate marketing and demand-generation requirements into scalable application, data, integration, and workflow architectures.
Partner with business and technology leaders to determine when capabilities should be built, integrated, extended, automated, or retired.
Drive a modular architecture that enables common capabilities and data to be reused across applications rather than repeatedly implemented within individual tools.
Establish technical standards for application development, APIs, integrations, data models, identity and access, observability, release management, and documentation.
Maintain a pragmatic technical roadmap balancing business value, platform sustainability, technical debt, security, and engineering capacity.

Application & Platform Ownership

Provide technical leadership for marketing applications and operational platforms supporting demand planning, campaign execution, program and event management, customer engagement, nominations, account intelligence, workflow, reporting, and automation.
Guide the evolution of applications from isolated tools toward interoperable services and shared platform capabilities.
Ensure common business entities, including accounts, contacts, programs, events, campaigns, opportunities, users, and marketing activities, are consistently represented and reusable across systems.
Lead integration with enterprise systems and data sources including CRM, account and contact data, commercial pipeline, financial data, analytics platforms, and identity services.
Establish appropriate system-of-record boundaries and controlled read/write integration patterns.
Oversee production reliability, application lifecycle management, upgrades, technical debt remediation, and operational support.

Engineering Leadership

Recruit, develop, mentor, and manage a high-performing team of MarTech engineers.
Provide technical direction while maintaining enough technical depth to review architecture, challenge design decisions, and unblock complex engineering problems.
Establish development practices covering source control, testing, code review, deployment, monitoring, incident management, and documentation.
Improve engineering velocity through reusable patterns, frameworks, shared services, and automation.
Establish clear ownership across applications, services, integrations, and data products.
Drive disciplined prioritization and prevent one-off solutions from creating unnecessary application or integration sprawl.

Data, Integration & Automation

added.description:
Senior Engineering Manager

Full time

San Francisco California | On site

About the Company

Our client is a fast-growing AI technology company focused on building machine learning and generative AI solutions for the tax and accounting industry. The company develops products that convert complex, unstructured tax documentation into accurate and reliable structured data used in high-value professional workflows.

The engineering organization is hands-on, collaborative, customer-focused, and product-driven, with a strong emphasis on technical excellence, reliability, and rapid execution.

What You Will Own

• Lead, coach, and develop a team of approximately 4 to 7 engineers, with the opportunity to expand the organization as the business grows.

• Set clear expectations, provide direct and timely feedback, manage performance proactively, and help senior engineers grow into broader technical and leadership roles.

• Own delivery across the product development lifecycle, from technical strategy and architecture through implementation, production deployment, reliability, and iteration.

• Remain an active technical contributor by writing production software, reviewing designs and pull requests, reading code, and debugging complex issues alongside the team.

• Partner closely with the CTO, product leaders, customers, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate business problems into durable product and platform capabilities.

• Lead the integration and development of teams and systems within the broader Thomson Reuters environment while preserving a fast, accountable engineering culture.

• Drive sound engineering practices in architecture, code quality, observability, testing, operational readiness, security, and scalable cloud infrastructure.

• Hire, onboard, and retain exceptional engineers, including senior, staff, and principal-level talent.

• Build external customer-facing products that solve real operational problems and deliver measurable value to accounting professionals.

Required Qualifications

• 10 or more years of software engineering experience, including meaningful progression from individual contributor responsibilities into formal engineering leadership.

• Demonstrated experience managing approximately 2 to 10 direct reports in a formal role such as Engineering Manager, Senior Engineering Manager, Tech Lead Manager, Senior Tech Lead Manager, or Director of Engineering.

• Current hands-on engineering involvement. You still write production software regularly, review technical designs and pull requests, and debug difficult problems with senior engineers.

• Strong backend engineering, backend infrastructure, distributed systems, or backend-generalist depth. Full-stack experience is relevant when supported by substantial backend expertise.

• Experience building or leading external, customer-facing software products in a fast-moving, technology-forward product company.

• Strong technical judgment and the ability to guide architecture, execution, prioritization, and quality without becoming a delivery-only or people-only manager.

• Proven people leadership, including coaching, candid feedback, performance management, career development, and creating accountability across senior teams.

• Ability and willingness to work on site five days per week in downtown San Francisco.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience hiring, onboarding, and scaling an engineering team, particularly teams that include staff and principal engineers.

• Exposure to production ML or AI systems, including agentic systems, retrieval-based applications, document intelligence, or evaluation-driven development.

• Professional experience with Python, TypeScript, cloud infrastructure, data-intensive systems, or AI-enabled product platforms.

• Experience operating through organizational integration, acquisition, or a transition from startup scale to enterprise scale.

• A track record of balancing rapid product iteration with reliability, maintainability, and disciplined engineering execution.

What Success Looks Like

• The engineering team has clear goals, strong accountability, and a consistent ability to ship high-quality customer-facing products.

• Senior engineers receive credible technical guidance and active coaching from a manager who can engage deeply in code and architecture.

• New integrations and organizational changes are handled effectively without losing speed, ownership, or product focus.

• Engineering practices scale with the business, and the team develops a strong bench of future technical and people leaders.

Work Arrangement and Immigration

This is an on-site position based in downtown San Francisco, with an expectation of five days per week in the office. Remote work is limited to approximately 10 days annually. Eligible visa transfers, including H-1B and TN, may be considered.

Ideal Leadership Profile

The strongest candidate is a true player-coach: a proven people leader who is still energized by code, architecture, and product problem solving. This person has succeeded in demanding product environments, has built software used directly by customers, and can earn the trust of staff and principal engineers through technical credibility. The role is not suited to a manager who has moved entirely away from hands-on engineering.
